name: @voxgig-sdk/univec-sdk
description: Unofficial generated TypeScript SDK for the UniVec public API. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the upstream API provider.

scripts.test-some: node -e "const p = process.env.npm_config_pattern || process.env.TEST_PATTERN; const r = require('child_process').spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--enable-source-maps', '--experimental-test-isolation=none', ...(p ? ['--test-name-pattern=' + p] : []), '--test', 'dist-test/**/*.test.js'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(r.status ?? 1)"
scripts.build: node -e "for (const p of process.argv.slice(1)) require('fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })" dist dist-test && tsc --build src test
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of process.argv.slice(1)) require('fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })" node_modules yarn.lock package-lock.json dist dist-test
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm i && npm run build && npm test
